messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered -> service=inference-eu-west metric=p99_latency value=3450ms threshold=2500ms. Pager: @oncall-eng. Incident ID: PD-98122
Maya: acked PD-98122. I'm on it, switching to thread.
Joaquin: seeing p99 spike across several dedicated pools in eu-west-1. Spike start ~10:12 UTC, sustained.
Maya: any recent deploys in that region?
deploy-bot: Deploy recorded: sidecar-service v3.4.1 -> eu-west-1 at 2026-03-17T10:09:12Z (deploy-id: dpl-7782)
Joaquin: suspicious — telemetry shows increased RPC parse time in sidecar processes. stack: sidecar -> tokenizer -> model-proxy. Parse latencies up x10.
Priya: I can rollback traffic from v3.4.1 -> v3.3.9 via the router. Suggest emergency rollback to stop parse regression.
Sam: I'll bump autoscaler min for inference-pool-eu-west to 6 to buy headroom. Doing now.
Sam: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment/inference-pool-eu-west --replicas=6`
Joaquin: KV cache eviction rate also elevated, maybe bad batching causing backpressure. Recommend disabling batching on sidecars in eu-west while we investigate.
Priya: starting gradual traffic shift: `redwood-router shift --service sidecar-service --from v3.4.1 --to v3.3.9 --region eu-west-1 --percent 20`
Maya: pinging support for customer impact list (Dedicated customers pinned to eu-west). Kira, can you prep comms?
Kira: Drafting short note for affected customers: "We observed increased request latency in eu-west causing degraded performance for a subset of Dedicated customers. We are rolling back a sidecar release and applying mitigations. Expect reduced latency within 10–20m. We'll follow up with RCA." LMK edits.
Priya: traffic shift at 20% -> 50% -> 100% completed over ~8m. Observed immediate p99 drop from 3450ms -> 1800ms at 50%.
Joaquin: disabling batching flag on sidecars in eu-west: `kubectl -n inference set env ds/sidecar REDWOOD_BATCHING=off --all` 
Joaquin: KV eviction rate dropping, CPU on sidecars back to normal.
Maya: monitoring dashboards — p95 down to 980ms, p99 ~1500ms and trending down. Not fully within SLO yet but improving.
Sam: autoscaler change held. Reverting min_replicas to previous value when stable.
Priya: leave a remediation note: create a canary test for the protobuf parsing path and add a perf gate on sidecar releases.
Maya: paging note: PD-98122 remains open until p99 < 2500ms for 15m. If that holds we can resolve.
Nate: I'll take second-shift oncall. Handoff: will watch for reappearance around peak at 18:00 UTC.
Maya: thanks team. Kira to send customer update. Priya/Joaquin to file post-incident tasks: rollback follow-up, perf regression test, canary perf gate.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note updated: PD-98122 -> acknowledged by Maya, handlers: Maya, Joaquin, Priya, Sam.
Maya: resolving thread for now, will re-open if PD re-fires. :white_check_mark:
